sessions.topic: Calibrating CLIP prototypes to distinguish novel classes from weather-shifted known classes
sessions.boundary_reason: The novelty detector is adopted; discussion turns to learning classes without forgetting.

sessions.topic: Ten-addition adapter baseline and replay–distillation sweep
sessions.boundary_reason: The best replay setting falls short of the known-class retention target, prompting a different approach.

sessions.topic: Class-specific LoRA modules and frozen known-class logits on WeatherShift-10
sessions.boundary_reason: WeatherShift-10 evaluation is complete; attention shifts to unseen sensor shifts.

sessions.topic: CameraShift-10 rejection and recall without recalibration
sessions.boundary_reason: Sensor-balanced analysis leads to a decision to defer CameraShift-10 deployment.
SensorCal-v1 improves rejection but misses the novel-recall target, motivating an augmentation ablation.

sessions.topic: Bayer and JPEG ablations and their effect on novel-class recall
sessions.boundary_reason: The JPEG investigation reaches a decision; discussion turns to Bayer coverage.

sessions.topic: Testing whether Bayer augmentation improves held-out-sensor coverage and recall
sessions.boundary_reason: Withholding a Bayer pattern exposes a deployment limitation, prompting a closer test of pattern matching.

sessions.topic: Matched versus mismatched Bayer patterns across sensors
sessions.boundary_reason: Conflicting sensor-wise results lead to a decision to use diverse prototypes with sensor-wise validation.
SensorGate-v1 meets the CameraShift-10 targets and is adopted.

sessions.topic: Uncertainty-gated sensor embeddings for unseen cameras
sessions.boundary_reason: The embeddings meet per-camera novelty targets; discussion moves to ten-addition integration.

sessions.topic: Integrating and auditing unseen-camera detection with ten-addition LoRA
